summary: In a championship session (global dword_7C56A4 == 7), checks whether the player's score plus one (obj+0x403C) matches any entry of a stride-2 threshold array rooted at this+0x164 with element count this+0x160. On a match, calls StateChangeNotify(this, 1) to trigger a championship state transition. Guards: enable flag at obj+0x4040 must be non-zero and at least one threshold entry must exist. Called on lap completion.

operations.description: Global session-type check: dword_7C56A4 must equal 7 (championship session) before anything else runs.
Dereference this+0x0 to obtain the player/championship data object pointer.
Enable-flag check: the value at obj+0x4040 (via *this + 16448) must be non-zero for the threshold check to proceed.
Compute the next threshold target as the player's score (obj+0x403C, via *this + 16444) plus one.
Element-count guard: this+0x160 must be greater than zero (at least one threshold entry exists) to enter the scan loop.
Iterate the stride-2 threshold array starting at this+0x164, comparing the even-indexed entries against the target score+1.
When an entry equals the target, call StateChangeNotify(this, 1) to signal the championship state transition.
Function returns void; no value is produced when guards fail or no threshold matches.

unresolved: The exact meaning of the obj fields at +0x403C (score) and +0x4040 (enable flag) and of the threshold values is inferred from context and not independently confirmed.
Whether StateChangeNotify may fire multiple times when several thresholds match the same target is unresolved.
